source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, v) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if v := grid[r][c]]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    diff_lines = {c - r for r, c, _ in cells}
    sum_lines = {r + c for r, c, _ in cells}
    use_sum = len(sum_lines) < len(diff_lines)
    offsets = sum_lines if use_sum else diff_lines
    period = len(offsets)
    pattern = {}
    for r, c, color in cells:
        d = r + c if use_sum else c - r
        key = d % period
        if key in pattern and pattern[key] != color:
            raise ValueError("inconsistent diagonal pattern")
        pattern[key] = color
    return [[pattern[(r + c if use_sum else c - r) % period]
             for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
'''
path.write_text(source)
print(path.read_text())

source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    diff_lines = {c - r for r, c, _ in cells}
    sum_lines = {r + c for r, c, _ in cells}
    use_sum = len(sum_lines) < len(diff_lines)
    offsets = sum_lines if use_sum else diff_lines
    period = len(offsets)
    pattern = {}
    for r, c, color in cells:
        d = r + c if use_sum else c - r
        key = d % period
        if key in pattern and pattern[key] != color:
            raise ValueError("inconsistent diagonal pattern")
        pattern[key] = color
    return [[pattern[(r + c if use_sum else c - r) % period]
             for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
'''
